title: Customer portal web assets blocked by object-storage access policy
alert_or_symptom: The Customer Web Portal remains available, but many product images, style assets and downloadable product documents cannot be retrieved from object storage.

technical_evidence.observation: Between 17:02 and 17:22, 73.6 percent of uncached product-image, stylesheet and product-document requests failed with HTTP 403 responses. Previously cached assets continued to load.
Failed asset requests reached the Object Storage Platform and received AccessDenied responses when the portal CDN origin identity attempted to retrieve the requested objects.
The active storage access policy does not contain the expected read permission for the Customer Web Portal CDN origin identity on the web-assets object path.

The Object Storage Platform is available, the affected objects remain present and integrity checks report no object loss or corruption. Other authorised storage clients continue to retrieve their objects successfully.

technical_evidence.source_name: Customer portal and API health summary
technical_evidence.observation: Portal HTML responses, product text, search, sign-in, basket updates, API requests and checkout transactions remain available and within normal operating thresholds.
A revised storage access policy was activated at 16:42. The active policy version omits the expected portal CDN-origin read permission that was present in the preceding approved version.

Customers across the United Kingdom and Ireland report missing product images, incomplete page styling and unavailable product-document downloads. Customers can still search, sign in, add items to baskets and complete checkout.

The evidence directly establishes an object-storage access-configuration failure affecting Customer Web Portal assets. It does not indicate storage-platform unavailability, object loss, application failure or API failure.

service_impact.user_impact_description: Customer Web Portal users may encounter missing product images, incomplete styling and unavailable document downloads, while core browsing, authentication, basket and checkout functions remain operational.
service_impact.business_function_affected: Presentation and delivery of customer-facing product assets
service_impact.workaround_description: Customers can continue using product text and complete purchases. Customer-support staff can provide essential product information through the approved support process, but normal asset presentation is not restored.

environmental_context: The Object Storage Platform is a Tier 2 important infrastructure service.
The Customer Web Portal is a Tier 1 customer-facing service and uses object storage for images, stylesheets and non-transactional documents.
Core application data and customer transactions are handled through other healthy services.
The affected objects remain present and no object-integrity failure has been detected.

recent_changes.description: A revised storage access policy was activated at 16:42 and omits the expected Customer Web Portal CDN-origin read permission.

reported_unknowns: Why the expected CDN-origin read permission was omitted from the active storage access policy.
The complete set of affected objects and the extent to which CDN caching is temporarily masking the failure.
Whether any additional approved storage consumers are affected by the revised access policy.
The expected time for an approved correction and full restoration of normal web-asset delivery.
additional_context: No object loss, corruption, customer-data exposure, transaction failure or serious security incident has been confirmed.
No storage permission, CDN configuration or production object should be changed outside the approved operational and change-control process.
